newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson links with Telia over Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson links with Telia over Atlantic.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Monday that it had been selected by major Swedish operator Telia to supply a total solution for telephony and Internet traffic across the Atlantic.
Ericsson said the move came as Telia UK Ltd put a new AXE TransLocal exchange into operation in London.
The aim was for Telia to create its own facilities from the U.S. in order to take a larger share of the international traffic.

"Ericsson's solutions increase Telia's capacity for carrying Internet traffic to and from the U.S. and Telia's customers will thus be offered faster and higher quality transmission of information," Ericsson spokesman Max Gerger said.
He said Ericsson is responsible for the total solution at Telia's new site in Manhattan, New York.
This includes switching equipment for international telephony services, routers and Synchronous Digitial Hierarchy transport network solution.
The new site will direct Nordic and Baltic-bound Internet traffic from the U.S. onto Telia's network.
